answer: Price each identity to one scarce hardware anchor that must sign a fresh proof every epoch, and let standing harden slowly like ONYX only as already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign your audited work. A verifier splits each endorsement through a PRISM so vouches tracing to one shared root overlap and cancel instead of stacking; a sybil fleet forked from a single wallet scatters like dust in a GALE, never gathering distinct cross-cluster signatures. Honest roots pay one anchor once; a farm pays a fresh anchor plus a slow climb per head, linear in headcount.
